objective: Recover named stack memory views without changing ordered checked guest-memory effects; sum/struct-fields O0 milestone
authority: shared master checkout, integrator only; workers isolated snapshots

successCriteria: explicit object/field/index addresses lower to existing IR
no host pointer dereference or extra bounds checks
modular address arithmetic and memory alias/fault regressions
entry-stack affine tracking on CFG fixed point
unknown/unequal joins and dynamic stack updates stay unknown
sequential assignment points and conservative bounded analysis
native C matches original IR including full-memory digest
O0 sum and struct-fields expose named stack views
existing faults and unresolved addresses retained

frozen_stack_api.query: offset_before(&self, instruction: u64, assignment: usize, address: &Expr) -> Option<i64>
frozen_stack_api.accesses: accesses(&self) -> &[StackAccess] where pub fields instruction:u64, assignment:usize, offset:i64, width:Width, kind:AccessKind
frozen_stack_api.point: assignment is zero-based; len means control; all expressions at assignment point use pre-assignment registers

frozen_hir_api.type: ViewPath::Object {name:String, base:Expr}, Field {base:Box<ViewPath>, offset:u64}, Index {base:Box<ViewPath>, index:Expr, stride:u64}
frozen_hir_api.rule: explicit views are metadata plus exact existing IR lowering; byte extent/type/ownership are not claimed

outputSchema.evidence: test commands/results, design limits, open issues; do not commit shared tree

stop: one bounded implementation and two repair rounds; no extra agents
